# CollectionGenerator

Generates collections from members in C#.

## Example

```cs
namespace ExampleNamespace;

public partial class ExampleClass {
    [AddTo("MyCollection")]
    public static readonly string TestString1 = "Hello";
    [AddTo("MyCollection")]
    public static readonly string TestString2 = "World";

    public static readonly ImmutableArray<string> MyCollection;
}
```

Generates:

```cs
// <auto-generated />

#nullable enable

namespace CollectionGenerator;

[System.AttributeUsage(System.AttributeTargets.Field | System.AttributeTargets.Property, AllowMultiple = true, Inherited = false)]
public sealed class AddToAttribute(params string[] ArrayNames) : System.Attribute {
    public string[] ArrayNames { get; } = ArrayNames;
}

```

```cs
// <auto-generated />

#nullable enable

namespace ExampleNamespace;

partial class ExampleClass {
    static ExampleClass() {
        MyCollection = [
            TestString1,
            TestString2,
        ];
    }
}

```
